// The annotations the language server reads. @role tags the first token of a
// symbol, and with the single modifier only a symbol of one token. @decl(kind)
// records an outline symbol unless it reduces inside a %scope.
%scope LB RB

program : items $

items   : items item
        | item

item    : 'FN' 'ID'@function@decl(function) block
        | 'VAR' 'ID'@variable@decl(variable) 'SEMI'
        | expr 'SEMI'

block   : 'LB' items 'RB'
        | 'LB' 'RB'

expr    : expr@function:single 'LP' 'RP'
        | expr 'DOT' 'ID'@property
        | 'ID'@variable
